description: This file contains unit tests for the QbonePacketExchanger class in the quic namespace, testing packet reading, writing, error handling, and interaction with a mock client and visitor.

classes.name: MockVisitor
classes.description: Mock implementation of QbonePacketExchanger::Visitor for testing error callbacks.

classes.name: FakeQbonePacketExchanger
classes.description: A test subclass of QbonePacketExchanger that allows simulation of packet read/write behavior and errors.

methods.name: AddPacketToBeRead
methods.description: Adds a packet to the queue to be returned by ReadPacket.

methods.name: SetReadError
methods.description: Sets an error string to simulate read errors.

methods.name: ForceWriteFailure
methods.description: Forces WritePacket to fail with specified blocked status and error message.

methods.name: packets_written
methods.description: Returns the list of packets successfully written.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Overrides QbonePacketExchanger::ReadPacket to simulate packet reading behavior.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Overrides QbonePacketExchanger::WritePacket to simulate packet writing behavior.
